system.description:
A polished performer trained in Eltor's noble courts — music, rhetoric, and the careful art of saying everything without saying anything.

  • Courtly Fascination: increase the DC of Fascinate's Will save by 2 against humanoids in a social environment — feast, court, or tavern. Your Discord can target two creatures within 30ft instead of one (each saves separately).
  • Silver Tongue: Advantage on Deception, Persuasion, and Etiquette checks in formal or courtly settings.
